title: Claude Dispatch makes Cowork way more useful.
description:
Claude Dispatch makes Cowork way more useful.

You can now text Claude a task from your phone, and it can run that task through your desktop setup.

So your phone becomes the instruction layer…

and your laptop does the actual work.

Use it for:

→ meeting prep
→ reports
→ file summaries
→ client updates
→ folder cleanup
→ connected app workflows
→ starting work before you’re back at your desk

Comment HELP and I’ll send the setup guide #claude #claudecowork #aitips
